app.about:
Feuillet {version}

Document scanning, watermarks and file conversion, fully offline.
Windows 10 and 11.

Free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0 licence.
Uses PyMuPDF (AGPL), OpenCV, Pillow, python-docx, pdf2docx, Qt (PySide6) and Tesseract OCR.
app.language_reset_warning: Changing the language resets the open tabs (original files are not affected). Continue?

app.title: Feuillet — Scan, watermark, convert
convert.accepted: Accepted formats: {types} — drag and drop your files here.
convert.desc.compress: Reduces file size by optimising images and structure. The result is never larger than the original.
convert.desc.convert_images: Changes the image format: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, ICO, AVIF. Animations are kept when the format allows it.
convert.desc.delete_pages: Creates a new PDF without the chosen pages.
convert.desc.excel_to_pdf: Converts Excel workbooks (XLS, XLSX), ODS or CSV to PDF, including all sheets.
convert.desc.extract_pages: Creates a new PDF with only the chosen pages.
convert.desc.images_to_pdf: Combines images (JPG, PNG, WebP…) into one PDF, one page per image, in list order. To straighten or enhance document photos, use the Scanner tab.
convert.desc.merge: Combines several PDFs into one, in list order (drag files to reorder).
convert.desc.ocr_pdf: Adds an invisible text layer to scanned pages: the text becomes selectable and searchable. The appearance does not change.
convert.desc.office_convert: Changes the format of a Word, Excel or PowerPoint document (e.g. DOC → DOCX, DOCX → ODT, XLS → XLSX, PPT → PPTX). The chosen format must match the document type.
convert.desc.page_numbers: Adds a number to the pages. {n} = page number, {total} = number of pages.
convert.desc.pdf_to_excel: Extracts the PDF's tables into an Excel workbook, one sheet per table. If no table is found, the text is copied line by line.
convert.desc.pdf_to_images: Saves each page as a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
convert.desc.pdf_to_powerpoint: One slide per page. Pages are images (not editable); their text is copied into the notes.
convert.desc.pdf_to_text: Extracts the PDF's text into a TXT file.
convert.desc.pdf_to_word: Creates an editable Word document (text, tables, images). A scanned PDF must first go through the 'OCR' tool.
convert.desc.powerpoint_to_pdf: Converts PowerPoint (PPT, PPTX) or ODP presentations to PDF, one slide per page.
convert.desc.protect: Encrypts the PDF (AES-256): the password will be asked when opening. Keep it safe: it cannot be recovered.
convert.desc.reorder: Changes the page order. Example: '3, 1, 2' puts page 3 first.
convert.desc.repair: Rebuilds the structure of a damaged PDF and saves a clean copy.
convert.desc.rotate: Rotates all pages or only some.
convert.desc.split: Splits a PDF: one page per file, blocks of N pages, or by ranges.
convert.desc.text_to_pdf: Lays out a text file (TXT), Markdown (MD) or a simple HTML page as PDF.
convert.desc.unlock: Removes the password from a PDF whose password you know.
convert.desc.word_to_pdf: Converts Word (DOC, DOCX), OpenDocument (ODT) or RTF documents to PDF, using Microsoft Word if installed, otherwise LibreOffice.

convert.opt.force: Redo OCR even on pages that already have text

settings.ocr_help:
OCR makes PDF text selectable and searchable, and is used for automatic orientation. It relies on the free Tesseract software, installed separately:
1. Download the Windows 64-bit installer from the UB Mannheim page.
2. During setup, under “Additional language data”, tick French.
3. Keep the suggested folder (C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR), then click “Check again”.
